_comment: Kept modules mapped to the functional units of CPU architecture.
The categories are ACM CF'25's, verbatim -- Fetch, Decode & Issue,
Int Exe, LSU, Retire, MMU, Icache, Dcache -- because that paper
reports a per-component power breakdown for CVA6, CVA6S+ and the
XuanTie C910 at the same boundary this study measures, on GF 22 FDX.
Using its names rather than our own is what makes the two
breakdowns comparable rather than merely similar.
Every name here is a module firtool emits, read out of the
elaborated hierarchy rather than chosen: XSCore is Frontend +
Backend + MemBlock, and the units are one or two levels below that.
'other' is the acceptance test. If it is large, this map is wrong.
